messages:
Maya (CS): FYI onboarding kickoff with CareHarbor today — they asked for an embeddings-specific DPA addendum and clarity on retention + KMS BYOK. timeline is tight, renewal in 3 months.
Eli (Solutions): Thanks — do we have a template addendum for embeddings retention? last time we patched something ad-hoc for a finance customer.
Jordan (Security): We have control descriptions for encryption-at-rest + envelope encryption. For embeddings retention we usually call out retention_period_days and deletion hooks. Can share snippet.
Grace (Legal): If it's PHI-adjacent (healthcare) we need a slightly different clause, plus attestations on key provenance if BYOK requested. @Maya can you confirm scope?
Maya (CS): CareHarbor confirmed it's de-identified outputs from their EHR pipeline, but legal needs to treat as regulated. They asked for: 1) retention window for embeddings, 2) ability to request bulk deletion, 3) BYOK with HSM-backed keys, 4) SOC2 evidence for key management. They want answers by EOD Thurs.
OnboardBot: New onboarding: CareHarbor — account created. Case ID: CH-2026-0042. Assigned: Maya (CS).
Eli (Solutions): Pasting a short example we can adapt:
```
embeddings_retention_days: 90
bulk_delete_api: /v1/tenant/{id}/embeddings:delete
kms_supported: HSM (BYOK), customer_key_rotation_enabled: true
```
Eli (Solutions): We'll need runtime config for non-prod buckets and confirmation that prefix caching won't persist embeddings beyond retention window.
Jordan (Security): For SOC2 evidence: we can provide the key rotation policy excerpt, KMS access audit logs (last 12 months), and our SOC2 control mapping for encryption (CC6/CC7 equivalents). Grace — will that satisfy their legal team?
Grace (Legal): Likely yes but ask CareHarbor if they need formal attestation or just copies of documents. If they want attestation we might need a bespoke addendum. Also confirm whether they need data residency (EU) clause.
Maya (CS): They said EU residency for a subset of customers. Action items: (1) Eli draft embeddings addendum (2) Jordan pull KMS artifact + control mapping (3) Grace check attestation language & DPA implications (4) I'll ping the customer with deadlines. Can owners confirm ETA by EOD?
Eli (Solutions): I can deliver a first draft tomorrow noon PST.
Jordan (Security): I'll pull the KMS logs and control mapping today, will upload to the secure drive and share link.
Grace (Legal): I'll draft two short paragraphs: attestation vs doc copy options and EU residency clause. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Maya (CS): Great — I'll tell CareHarbor we'll respond with proposed addendum + artifacts by Friday. If anything changes, flag it here. :thumbsup:
